scripts.sync:polymarket: node -e "const token=process.env.INTERNAL_API_TOKEN; if(!token) throw new Error('INTERNAL_API_TOKEN is required'); fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/internal/sync/polymarket',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json','x-internal-api-token':token},body:JSON.stringify({scope:'markets',mode:'incremental',limit:1000})}).then(async r=>{console.log(await r.text()); if(!r.ok) process.exit(1);})"
